segments.title: Cold Open: Papito Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito (as Papito) delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on from a gamer setup, declaring the show live in casual mode.

segments.title: Case & Kendelle: Dance Battle Sub Goal & Patreon Reminder
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle discuss a non-consensual dance battle sub goal (Kendelle's champion: their cat Tony Tony), and Case notes the 6 PM Patreon deadline.

segments.title: Behind the Scenes: Green Screen Tour & Toilet Egg-Dying Project
segments.notes: Case reveals the minimalist studio (green screen only) and details the clandestine content experiment: a $90 Lowe's toilet bought for egg-dying videos after Kendelle banned use of household toilets.

segments.title: Content Strategy Leak: Plastic Eggs, Cheating Accusations, Viral Math
segments.notes: Case admits plastic eggs don't dye, accuses a viral competitor of swapping eggs, and outlines a 30-video pipeline to force a TikTok viral hit from a zero-follower account.

segments.title: Community Thank-Yous & Hype Train Absence
segments.notes: Case reads sub/bit acknowledgments (Brian Westwood, Google Trash, Skymer, Wolfdog) and notes Hype Train is unavailable today.

segments.title: Hat-Pull Archive Review: Five Community Ideas
segments.notes: Case replays the idea-pull stream: 'do drugs' (Skymer), 'cats' (Exterminator 13), 'die eggs in toilet' (Apple to Apple), 'recipes for your dog' (Live in Sleazy), and a fifth unrevealed idea.

segments.title: Pivot to Gamer Stream: Slay the Spire Multiplayer
segments.notes: Case declares the broadcast a gaming stream, loads Slay the Spire, and awaits Tim for co-op Ascension 10 run.

segments.title: Slay the Spire Co-op: Ironclad & Tag Team Synergy
segments.notes: Case (Ironclad) and Tim play multiplayer; key relics: Hidden Gem, Miniature Tent, Royal Stamp; Case jackpots aggressively, takes curse for gold, and they crush elites.

segments.title: Kendelle Departs for 'Ronald Does Dallas'; Website Crisis
segments.notes: Kendelle leaves for a movie (Ronald Does Dallas / Ronald with the Huge Hog); chat helps Kendall source a Wix website designer (Starship Operator, Exterminator 13 offer).

segments.title: Final Act Push & Near-Death Climax
segments.notes: Case plays recklessly (jackpot every turn), nearly dies, Tim saves with Blood Potion; they clear Act 1 elite but fall short of boss with six minutes left.

segments.title: Sign-Off: No News Today, Raid to Tim's Channel
segments.notes: Case confirms no news happened, declares chill day, raids Tim's blank channel, and signs off mid-conversation with Tim.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored a non-news gaming broadcast, revealed clandestine toilet egg-dying content farm, co-opped Slay the Spire with Tim.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open as 'Papito' from a gamer setup, declared casual mode live.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through studio, negotiated dance battle champion (cat Tony Tony), left for movies, crowdsourced Wix website help.

characters.name: Tim
characters.notes: call-in guest. Joined for Slay the Spire multiplayer; Ascension 10 veteran, better chat reader, saved Case with Blood Potion.

lore_notes.fact: Purchased a $90 toilet from Lowe's for egg-dying content after Kendelle prohibited use of household toilets. [10:51]
Cracked the toilet while unpacking; held together with white porcelain tape. [34:37]
Running a clandestine TikTok/YouTube experiment: posting egg-dying videos from a zero-follower account to force a viral hit without revealing the channel. [21:43]
Seeking paid website designer for boutique Wix site; chat candidates include Starship Operator and Exterminator 13. [01:20:25]
Has beaten Slay the Spire Ascension 10 on every character in solo mode. [01:09:57]

episode_summary: Barely Informed News abandoned its nightly rundown for a casual gaming broadcast after anchor Case Blackwell admitted the news cycle was too light. Executive producer Pepito opened as 'Papito' from a gamer rig, then Case and Kendelle dissected a covert content operation involving a garage toilet, plastic eggs, and a 30-video TikTok viral pipeline. The remainder of the hour featured a Slay the Spire co-op run with guest Tim, culminating in a near-wipe on Act 1 and a raid to Tim's dormant channel.
